**Publish gate report: About page**

**Going out:** About page copy, public, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website.

**Claim check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | On policy list (Companies House) |
| "a small team of six" | Product fact (team size), fine as written |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | On policy list (Operations) |
| "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" | **Unproven.** Policy only backs "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website". A 98% five-star figure is an invented stat and contradicts a 4.8 average. |
| "we buy from gardens we've visited" | **Unproven.** Not on the policy list and not a product fact (sourcing visits aren't listed). Needs proof or removal. |

**Regulated claims:** None touched (no health, money, environment, price claims).

**House style:** No banned words. Voice is plain and warm enough. Fine.

**Disclosure:** Not an ad or partnership. Nothing needed.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite, not yet approved):**
> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. Our customers rate us 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. `[PROOF NEEDED: evidence that the team has visited the gardens it buys from, otherwise drop this]`

**Needs a decision:**
1. Do we have evidence of garden visits? My suggestion: cut the line unless Sam can confirm it and it's added to the policy.
2. Use the 4.8 / 1,200 reviews wording in place of the 98% claim (my suggestion).

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Not approved yet. Please don't publish the original draft; once the rewrite is settled, I'll need Sam's explicit yes to the final text.
